categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Yuanxiang New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of precipitated silica (silicon dioxide) products. Its main product lines include silica for silicone rubber reinforcement, toothpaste silica, PE battery separator silica, coating matting silica, defoaming silica, and insulation materials. The company also provides rubber compounding services. The core business is centered on precipitated silica used mainly in silicone rubber applications, with expanding applications in other industrial fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs the precipitation method to produce silica by neutralizing sodium silicate with sulfuric acid, followed by processes including dissolution, reaction, filtration, drying, and pulverization. It uses a DCS system to precisely control reaction parameters such as material ratios, flow, temperature, time, and pH to ensure product quality and stability. The company has developed proprietary technologies for controlling particle size distribution and surface modification of silica, supported by 54 patents including 31 invention patents. It integrates independent R&D with industry-academia collaboration to innovate and improve production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are manufacturers of silicone rubber products, mainly located in the developed silicone rubber industrial regions of East, South, and Central China. End markets include electronics, electrical wires and cables, insulators, automotive, daily necessities, and medical fields. Other application markets include toothpaste manufacturers, battery separator producers, coatings, defoaming agents, and insulation materials. The company maintains stable relationships with major downstream silicone rubber producers and is expanding into new application areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with its production base located in Shaowu City, Fujian Province. Its sales are predominantly domestic, accounting for over 99% of revenue, with minor exports to regions including Europe, South Korea, Brazil, and Southeast Asia. The company is actively developing its presence in international markets leveraging cost and quality advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Yuanxiang New Materials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical materials supply chain, focusing on the production of precipitated silica as a chemical raw material and filler. It sources upstream raw materials such as sodium silicate and sulfuric acid and supplies downstream manufacturers of silicone rubber and other industrial products. The company has integrated R&D, production, and sales functions, maintaining control over the entire value chain of its core products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening its R&D capabilities and product quality to maintain leadership in the silicone rubber silica segment. It emphasizes continuous process innovation, cost reduction, and product performance enhancement, including high-dispersion and surface-modified silica products. The company is expanding R&D efforts into new application fields such as toothpaste, battery separators, coatings, defoaming agents, and insulation materials. It plans to enhance production capacity, optimize internal management, and build a modern enterprise management system while fostering industry integration and circular economy development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precipitated silica products to industrial customers, especially silicone rubber manufacturers. The company adopts a direct sales model with sales personnel providing customer service and support. It also earns revenue from rubber compounding services. The revenue is mainly from product sales recognized at the point of delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer in the high-temperature vulcanized (HTV) silicone rubber silica segment, recognized as a 'specialized and innovative small giant' and a 'national manufacturing champion' by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It holds a top position in production volume and sales within its niche. Its main competitors include other domestic and international silica producers serving the silicone rubber and chemical filler markets. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, stable product quality, and cost advantages over foreign competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 471.3 million, representing a 19.68% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 48.22 million, up 40.15% year-over-year. The company’s silica product sales volume increased by 26.44% to over 80,000 tons. Total assets were about RMB 961.6 million at year-end 2024, with a slight decrease compared to the previous year. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by capacity expansion and market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, stability, and advanced production technology as its core competitive advantages. Its precipitated silica products offer superior dispersion, transparency, anti-yellowing, and mechanical reinforcement properties tailored for silicone rubber applications. The company’s cost-effective production and proprietary technologies enable it to compete effectively against international brands. It also focuses on expanding product applications and providing customized solutions to meet diverse customer needs, thereby enhancing customer loyalty and market position.
